title: Higgs Field Discovery

Physicist Peter Higgs' simple equation led to a groundbreaking idea about the universe. The Higgs field explains how particles acquire mass, a crucial piece of the Standard Model of particle physics puzzle. Scientists continue to explore and refine this concept, driving new research and discoveries in physics.
